segment_strategy.Casual Low-Engagement: Build the ordering habit: discounts on the next 3 orders, personalised recommendations and reminder notifications.
segment_strategy.Loyal Regulars: Reward and retain: VIP tier, early access to new restaurants, referral bonuses and birthday rewards.
segment_strategy.High Spenders: Protect high-value orders: priority delivery, free delivery on large orders, premium bundles and proactive compensation for any delay.
segment_strategy.Unrewarded Regulars: They order often but hold few points: run double-points weeks, show the points balance after each order and enrol them in the loyalty tier.
segment_strategy.Dormant Point Holders: They have many points but order rarely: send points-expiry reminders and "redeem your points" offers to bring them back.
